data.one_liner: Foundational types, protocol verb builders, and utilities for the Atsign Protocol SDK.
data.what_it_does: Provides core types like AtKey representation, metadata configurations, validation for atSigns, exception hierarchies, and wire-format protocol verb builders. It is a pure-Dart utility library used across other atPlatform components.
use_when: You need to construct an AtKey by hand in lower-level Atsign code.
You are building or parsing Atsign protocol wire-format verbs directly.
You need to handle Atsign-specific exception hierarchies.
avoid_when: You are writing a standard Flutter application and can use higher-level client packages instead.
You do not use the Atsign protocol in your project.
strengths: Pure-Dart implementation with no client-specific dependencies.
Provides robust static factory methods for key shapes (self, shared, public, local).
weaknesses: Too low-level for most standard application developers who should use at_client instead.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to your pubspec.yaml file.
